name: Folimeld
short_description: Visually rearrange, rotate, insert, and delete PDF pages with local-first privacy.
full_description:
Folimeld is an intuitive and powerful tool that gives you complete control over your PDF page structure. Ported from the acclaimed desktop version, it is now optimized for Android devices and Chrome OS.

[Key Features]
🎨 Visual Page Editing
Easily reorder pages using a clear thumbnail grid with intuitive touch or mouse operations.

🔄 Batch Operations
Perform moves, rotations, and deletions on multiple pages simultaneously. Includes multi-level Undo/Redo for worry-free editing.

➕ Page Insertion & Blank Pages
Seamlessly insert pages from other PDFs or add blank pages for notes within your existing documents.

🔒 Security & Password Management
Support for setting and removing PDF passwords, allowing you to manage sensitive documents securely.

⚙️ Advanced Document Settings
Modify PDF versions, page layouts (single, two-page, etc.), and reading directions (L2R/R2L).

💻 Desktop Experience (Chrome OS)
Optimized for Chromebooks and external keyboards. Standard shortcuts like Ctrl+S and Ctrl+Z work exactly as you expect.

🛡️ Privacy First
Folimeld never sends your files to external servers. All processing happens locally on your device, ensuring your confidential documents remain private.

From organizing business reports to adjusting scanned documents, Folimeld is your go-to tool for everything related to PDF structure.
